body.name: \(\mathcal C_k^\dagger\)
body.def: \(\mathcal C_k^\dagger=\mathcal R_B\cap\mathcal D_k^\dagger\). At least one eligible child exists at every depth because the closed children cover the selected parent box and \(\mathcal C_k^\dagger\) contains a minimizer. Thus \(\mathcal C_{k+1}^\dagger\subseteq\mathcal C_k^\dagger\), every selected cell is nonempty and closed, and \(\operatorname{diam}(\mathcal C_k^\dagger)\le\sqrt{2K}(1-\rho)2^{-k}\to0\).
